Thông Thái Space uses PostgreSQL 18 managed via Prisma ORM. All primary keys are CUIDs. The following tables describe the core and AI-related entities.

Claude Sonnet is billed per million tokens. The estimatedCostUsd is computed as follows:
skip + take with orderBy createdAt desc
Rate limiting: 100 requests / 60 seconds per user, enforced via Redis-backed @nest-lab/throttler-storage-redis.

Thông Thái Space needed a comprehensive platform to manage multiple client projects simultaneously, track tasks and timelines, generate AI-powered proposals, manage invoicing, maintain real-time team communication, and showcase portfolio projects.
